model: Axis A = own as component (promote/wrap/adopt-existing); Axis B = conform to look (mandatory for all). rule-of-2 trips a pattern onto the radar.

candidates.pattern: Hand-rolled labeled native field:
candidates.donorTarget: NativeField (archetype I, component kind) — the labeled-field assembly (label + control + hint + error + a11y) composing Input/Textarea/Label, plus a tokenized range slider
candidates.axisB: on-token (rides shared field chrome + accent-primary range)
candidates.notes: Promoted 2026-07-23 as the second Component-kind archetype (I, raw-input): NativeField. The <input\b scan splits into already-solved gaps (file->FileField, color->ColorField, cell->CellInput), adoption debt (text/checkbox/select where a primitive exists or the repo has none), and the genuinely un-homed shape this promotes: the labeled-native-field triad with the universal fleet gap being accessibility (no label association / aria-invalid / aria-describedby), plus native-only types with no shadcn wrapper (mistra's range x4, date/time). Scoped to the standalone labeled field: booleans stay Checkbox/Switch, enums stay Select, grid cells stay CellInput. scanSignal kept as 'raw-input' so the deterministic fleet scan keeps tracking regressions.

candidates.pattern: Raw <label> hand-rolled + control (incl. non-native Select), no htmlFor/aria wiring — the label-side view of the un-homed labeled-field triad
candidates.donorTarget: NativeField (archetype I, raw-input) — the labeled-field assembly closes the label-association a11y gap this signal tracks
candidates.axisB: token parity with the shared field chrome
candidates.notes: Promoted 2026-07-23 via archetype I (raw-input / NativeField) — the SAME molecule the 'raw-input' candidate promotes, tracked here from the complementary '<label' scan angle (a raw <label> around a Select has no bare <input>, so the raw-input scan alone would miss it). A separate 'field' promotion (Fd) was drafted from this signal and dropped as a duplicate once raw-input merged first (one archetype owns the shape). RESIDUAL: NativeField deliberately scopes OUT enum controls ('enums stay Select'), so the label+wiring assembly around a shadcn Select — the dominant raw-label shape in controlling-app's filter toolbars — is now covered by archetype S (raw-select / SelectField), promoted 2026-07-24 — the labeled enum-field assembly with the a11y wiring this label-side signal tracks. (Resolved as its own sibling archetype rather than a NativeField slot: SelectField owns the enum control, NativeField the native input.) scanSignal kept as 'raw-label' so the deterministic fleet scan keeps tracking <label> regressions.

candidates.pattern: Labeled multi-line text field re-hand-composed at every call site (label + textarea + helper/error), + optional char-count and mono/JSON variant
candidates.donorTarget: TextareaField (archetype T) — Label + Textarea atom + helper/error slot + optional showCount threshold counter + mono variant
candidates.notes: Promoted 2026-07-23 as Component-kind archetype T (raw-textarea): TextareaField composes the shadcn Textarea + Label atoms, binding-neutral (useState or RHF), with opt-in maxLength char-counter (muted->amber->destructive) and mono/JSON variant. No auto-resize built — fleet-wide search for scrollHeight/field-sizing/auto-resize came back empty. Field composition met rule-of-2 across all 7 projects; mono variant across controlling-app + mistra; counter a repeated idiom within brickshop.

candidates.pattern: Hand-rolled labeled enum field:
candidates.donorTarget: SelectField (archetype S, component kind) — the labeled enum-field assembly (label + choice control + hint + error + a11y) composing the shadcn Select + Label, with options as {value,label}[] data
candidates.notes: Promoted 2026-07-24 as the enum sibling of I (raw-input) and T (raw-textarea): archetype S (raw-select / SelectField). Closes the RESIDUAL the raw-label entry flagged when raw-input scoped enums OUT — the label+wiring assembly around a Select. Fleet is genuinely split native <select> (my-finance ~34 sites 100% native, mistra 11 files, dashboard 2, brickshop CellSelect) vs shadcn <Select> (controlling + brickshop all-shadcn), so the contract is control-agnostic and the baseline binds to the canonical shadcn Select. Universal gap closed: label association (aria-labelledby — Radix trigger is a button, htmlFor won't associate), aria-invalid, aria-describedby, and a standardized placeholder/none affordance (real option, not a __none__ sentinel). Options carried as {value,label}[] data — the convention no fleet project reached (all pass <option>/<SelectItem> markup per site). Scoped OUT: multiselect, combobox/cmdk, async-search, filter-bar label-less selects, and the flush grid-cell select (CellSelect sibling). scanSignal kept as 'raw-select' so the deterministic fleet scan keeps tracking regressions.

candidates.pattern: Hand-rolled overline/eyebrow/kicker label above a heading: uppercase + tracking-* + small size + muted color, re-typed inline or copied as a class const; some sites recolor it per domain state/category (the 'typed' layer)
candidates.donorTarget: Overline (archetype O, component kind) — composes the donor's existing OVERLINE_CLASS base signature + a closed semantic tone set (muted/foreground/primary/inverted) and an `as` element choice
candidates.axisB: on-token (rides OVERLINE_CLASS; tones map to design tokens)
candidates.notes: Promoted 2026-07-24 as archetype O (overline-typed / Overline), a fleet synthesis. The base signature ALREADY lived in the donor (src/components/layout/overline.ts → OVERLINE_CLASS, composed by SectionHeading/SurfaceHeader/BottomNav/StatTile/BoardColumn); what the fleet kept re-inventing was (1) a component to compose instead of a bare string and (2) the semantic tone layer. mistra + hk-crm each keep a drifted copy of OVERLINE_CLASS (text-xs/0.08em vs text-[10.5px]/0.09em); my-finance-app inlines it at ~5 sites AND recolors per category via EXPENSE_TYPE_COLORS (proves the typed need); dashboard inlines a muted variant at ~7 sites. Overline wraps OVERLINE_CLASS (never re-types it) and adds a closed, token-backed tone set — muted (base), foreground (louder), primary (brand), inverted (text-primary-foreground/80, generalizing hk-crm's headerFillClasses().kicker for solid headers). Arbitrary per-category color stays a className passthrough (the one sanctioned per-site deviation), NOT a new tone. Existing donor consumers keep composing OVERLINE_CLASS directly — adopting <Overline> is drift-tracked, not forced. scanSignal kept as 'overline-typed' so the deterministic fleet scan keeps tracking regressions.

candidates.pattern: Compact single-choice mode/filter/view toggle: a bordered track of equal pills where one is active (Table·Cards; All·Unread·Mentions; Day·Week·Month; List·Grid·Timeline), hand-rolled as a row of <button>s toggling bg-primary, with drifted padding and no keyboard/ARIA model
candidates.donorTarget: SegmentedControl (archetype Sg, component kind) — the donor ui/segmented-control primitive (Radix radio-group: one tab stop, arrow-key move+select, radiogroup/radio roles), now formalized as an archetype
candidates.notes: Promoted 2026-07-24 as component-kind archetype Sg (segmented-toggle / SegmentedControl). Axis-A adopt-existing, not a fresh build: the molecule was already consolidated into the donor ui/ layer (ui/segmented-control.tsx, backed by @radix-ui/react-radio-group, fully tested) — its own JSDoc records fixing four hand-rolled demos with drifted px-2/px-2.5/px-3 padding. Fleet rule-of-2 verified: brickshop-manager carries a bespoke plain-<button> copy with hand-rolled onKeyDown; hk-crm vendored the donor primitive verbatim (design-baseline@… vendor stamp). This promotion adds the missing archetype scaffolding around the existing atom — stack-agnostic contract, shipped typed export (re-export primitives dir, no duplicate) + music-library gallery demo as the binding, MANIFEST entry — so downstream repos inherit the contract (when to reach for it + its keyboard/a11y model), not merely a stray component. NOTE: the promotion brief also named mistra + controlling-app as hand-rollers, but a full grep (aria-pressed, ToggleGroup, radiogroup, pill-track, Tabs, viewMode) found NO segment/toggle code in either — the verified evidence is brickshop + hk-crm + the donor itself. Scoped OUT: tab-strip navigation (Tabs), binary on/off (Switch), multi-select filter bars, and the labeled enum form field (archetype S, raw-select/SelectField — it owns a label/placeholder/error a mode toggle lacks). scanSignal kept as 'segmented-toggle' so the deterministic fleet scan keeps tracking regressions.

candidates.pattern: Circular avatar for a named entity: initials derived from a name, optional image with initials fallback, tinted/brand circle
candidates.donorTarget: EntityAvatar (archetype E, component kind) — name-driven avatar: entityInitials() + optional image w/ fallback + size scale + muted/primary tone + accessible name
candidates.axisB: on-token (muted/primary token pairs; no off-token hue palette)
candidates.notes: Promoted 2026-07-24 as Component-kind archetype E (entity-circle): EntityAvatar, the name-driven sibling of IconAvatar. Fleet synthesis distilled to rule-of-2 (brickshop user avatar: initials from full_name + fixed bg-primary + dead src=''; mistra speaker roster: initialsFrom() + positional AVATAR_TINTS + fixed size-7). Three named repos were tangents, not instances: controlling-app (numbered wizard-step circle), hk-crm (unused vendored baseline Avatar), pmo (project-color palette on text/bars + status dots). Distilled shape is name->initials + optional image w/ fallback + accessible name; entityInitials() is the shared, tested deriver both sources hand-rolled. Color deliberately conformed to look: muted (default) + primary tones only — fleet's multi-hue palettes (mistra, pmo) are off-token AND positionally buggy (same entity recolors on reorder), and baseline has no categorical hue token set to hash across; per-entity hue variety is a documented project-local extension (L7). Universal gap closed: accessible name (alt/aria-label = entity name) — every hand-rolled copy left initials unlabeled. Scoped OUT: icon holder (IconAvatar), numbered step indicator, status/tag dots, avatar stacks. scanSignal kept as 'entity-circle' so the deterministic fleet scan keeps tracking regressions.
